sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The only approval for Chisone on BR-310 is for Pinerolo. The approved supplier list has no approval for Beinasco (PLT-BEI) with CUST-NOR, so delivery there is not released.

sources.quote: Moving production to another site is a change of source.

A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before
the first shipment.
BR-310,"Roof rail bracket, extruded and cut",PRG-Y,A,MAT-6082-T5,COAT-TCP,

findings.why: BR-310 is on PRG-Y, a Nordhavn program. Moving it to Beinasco counts as a change of source under CSR-NOR-R2. Written Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) is needed before the first shipment, and no approval in the documents covers it.

sources.quote: 8D report 8D-25-031. Supplier: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Opened 2025-03-20. Status: open.

cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
the supplier; found at incoming inspection on BR-310.
The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet, corrective action still being verified.

findings.why: Chisone has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material, the alloy family of BR-310 (6082-T5), and the report names BR-310 itself. The 2026-11-06 re-audit restored company standing only; it did not close the 8D.
